fields.statement: QA with a binary built from the branch head, in a scratch repo with a local bare origin and a fake gh: change set Ship it updated store's statement, then change set Other landed its own statement write. rhiza land --json exited 3 with error.conflict naming node, op, other change set and aspects [field:statement]; the human message is unchanged. rhiza ship check then rhiza ship land exited 3 with the same body and the ship state gained model_conflict (node, op, change_set, aspects, head). ship check --model-conflict --json passed (exit 0) with refused_change_set, intent 'Ship it', change_set and other_intent 'Other'; it failed with 'no model conflict is recorded' before any land, failed with 3 commits carrying Review: RUNX and Model-Conflict: when RHIZA_RUN=RUNX (passed for another run ID), failed once the branch moved past the recorded head, and refused --conflicts beside it (exit 2). After rhiza set store --rebase and a trailer commit, ship land landed, pushed and cleared model_conflict from the state. Scoped tests internal/api -run 'Ship|Land' (from a worktree outside ~/code) and internal/model pass. Minor: the passing human line reads 'open from cs/ship-it', not the conflict.

QA with a binary built from the branch head: rhiza workflow check ship-change reports the workflow valid (only the expected bypass warning, now naming model-conflict-fix); rhiza workflow describe ship-change shows land on.fail land-triage, land-triage on.fail land-conflict-triage, land-conflict-triage on.pass model-conflict-fix with no on.fail, and model-conflict-fix an agent step on.pass gate-land whose prompt names rhiza set --rebase and the Change:, Actor:, Review: and Model-Conflict: trailers; the repo's .rhiza/workflows copy matches the built-in from land to wait-landed. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... and the run-ship-model-conflict and describe-golden testscripts pass (the fixer case goes land fail, land-triage fail, land-conflict-triage pass, one model-conflict-fix, gate-land, land pass and merges; a refused push ends at land-conflict-triage with no fixer).
